title: Infant formula, Similac Sensitive, powder, made with bottled water

content.title: About
content.content: Similac Sensitive is a powdered infant formula designed for babies with sensitive digestion. It contains partially hydrolyzed protein, pre‑biotics and enzymes that help reduce gastrointestinal discomfort. Preparation is done with bottled water, ensuring a consistent composition and safety.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Similac Sensitive is specifically formulated for infants prone to colic and gas.
The formula includes partially hydrolyzed casein, which is easier to digest than intact protein.
Pre‑biotics (FOS) are added to promote the growth of beneficial gut bacteria.
The product is lactose‑free, making it suitable for infants with lactose intolerance.
Each package is sized for one serving prepared with 30 ml of bottled water.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Hydrolyzed protein and pre‑biotics help reduce bloating and colic in babies.

items.title: Balanced nutrition
items.content: Provides essential proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals needed for infant growth.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for infants with lactose intolerance, lowering the risk of diarrhea and discomfort.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc contribute to a stronger immune system.

items.title: Easy preparation
items.content: Just add 30 ml of bottled water, stir well, and the formula is ready for feeding.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with a known cow‑milk protein allergy may react to this formula.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: Too concentrated or too diluted a mixture can lead to dehydration or nutrient deficiency.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Keep the powder in a dry place; moisture can cause clumping and spoilage.

items.title: Water temperature
items.content: Use water around body temperature (≈37 °C); water that is too hot can degrade nutrients.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Measure one scoop (8 g) of powder, add 30 ml of bottled water, and stir thoroughly until smooth. Warm to body temperature if needed before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days. Discard if the formula develops an off‑smell, color change, or unusual taste.
